result.summary: Registered six safe in-window Ukrainian official source items for the missing 05:00–24:00 UTC interval: three General Staff publications and three DSNS aftermath updates. Canonical URLs, minute-level timestamps, quote locators, attribution, revision lineage, and explicit exclusions were preserved. Live air-attack routing, precise strike targets, granular frontline and emergency-response locations, and attached media were withheld; no final assessment or report narrative was created.
coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews do not provide API-grade completeness, stable content hashes, or complete edit history.
The scan retained only a bounded set of material primary publications and is not exhaustive across all Ukrainian official institutions.
Live air-attack and precise strike-target publications were withheld because their route, target, and active-status detail could be operationally sensitive.
DSNS casualty and damage figures remain attributable official statements and were not independently assessed in this discovery task.
The SAG-U/NSATU transfer post references US and NATO statements whose primary records were not separately collected in this shard.
No attached media was downloaded, hashed, or independently verified.
